process_area.title: Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling

value_stream.name: Customer Pickup, Loading Zone & Will-Call Counter Operations

fields.Owner: VP Store Operations / Customer Pickup & Loading-Zone Program Manager
fields.Participants: Store Ops (VS-07), CX (VS-13), Ecommerce (VS-10), HSE (VS-24), Real Estate/Facilities (VS-20/VS-138), Self-Haul Rental (VS-162)

workflows.name: Customer Pickup, Will-Call & Loading-Zone Program Strategy & Operating Model

Automation Opportunity: - Capacity modeling; appointment engine; CX/throughput dashboards; standard-publish via store-comms (VS-63)
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: standard documented; capacity model; safety model HSE-aligned; KPIs tracked
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (store ops), VS-10 (BOPIS/ecommerce), VS-162 (self-haul), VS-147 (premises safety), VS-24 (HSE), VS-63 (store comms), VS-37/VS-109 (open/remodel); sets inputs for W4962–W4968
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inconsistency risk**: Each store running pickup/loading differently → CX/safety variance; mitigated by the standard + store-comms
- **Capacity-blindness risk**: No appointment/capacity model → loading-bay queues; mitigated by the appointment model (W4963)
- **Safety-model risk**: Forklift-in-customer-area without a clear protocol → injury (VS-147); mitigated by the HSE-aligned safety model
System Touchpoints: - Store-comms/task (VS-63); order management (VS-10/VS-16); WMS/staging (VS-04); HSE (VS-24); facilities (VS-138); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Set the customer-pickup/will-call/loading-zone strategy & operating model: the will-call counter standard, the loading-bay model (drive-through vs back-of-house staging vs curbside), the appointment/time-slot model, the forklift-in-customer-area safety model (links VS-147/VS-24), the staffing/role model (counter, spotter, forklift operator, loader), and the CX/throughput KPIs
steps.r: Program Manager / Store Ops / CX / HSE

steps.activity: Build the operating standards: per-store loading-bay/zone capacity, signage/wayfinding (W4964), the customer-identification/release protocol (W4962), the SLA (order ready, wait time, load time), the appointment cadence (W4963), and the integration with BOPIS/ecommerce (W4967) and self-haul rental (W4968)
steps.r: Program Manager / Store Ops / CX / IT

steps.activity: Govern the program across 200 stores: store-comms rollout (VS-63), training (links VS-19.4/VS-124), performance review (W4981), and continuous improvement; integrate into store-opening (VS-37) and remodel (VS-109) standards

fields.Participants: Will-Call Counter Staff, Store Ops (VS-07), CX (VS-13), LP (VS-23)
fields.Trigger: Customer arrival for pickup; order ready notification (W4966)
fields.Volume: ~5–8% bulky-pickup share of ~2.8M monthly transactions across 200 stores (~140,000–220,000/month)

workflows.name: Will-Call Counter Operations, Order Staging & Customer Identification/Release

Automation Opportunity: - Order/ID auto-verify; QR/order-number scan; status auto-update on release; counter-queue dashboard
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: ID/order verified before release; release captured; exceptions routed; privacy-compliant (VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to VS-10/VS-16 (order mgmt), VS-04 (staging), VS-91 (privacy), VS-08 (POS lookup), VS-32 (returns), VS-13 (CX), VS-23 (LP), W4965 (staging), W4970 (loading), W4974 (carry-out)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrong-customer-release risk**: Order released to the wrong person → loss/fraud (VS-23); mitigated by ID/order verification
- **Missing-order risk**: Customer arrives but order not staged → CX failure; mitigated by readiness controls (W4965)
- **Counter-queue risk**: Counter bottleneck → wait/abandonment; mitigated by appointment/queue mgmt (W4963/W4966)
System Touchpoints: - Order management (VS-10/VS-16); WMS/staging (VS-04); ID/identity (VS-91); POS/POS lookup (VS-08); returns (VS-32)
Time Estimate: - ~3–7 min per pickup at counter (verify + release + handoff)

steps.activity: Identify the customer & verify the order: at the will-call counter, verify customer identity/order (ID + order number — links VS-91 privacy, prevent wrong-customer release), pull the staged order (W4965), and confirm the order/items/condition with the customer before release

Release & document: release the order to the customer, capture the pickup confirmation/signature, update the order status (links VS-10/VS-16 — complete the fulfillment), and hand off to loading (W4970) or carry-out (W4974) for bulky goods

Manage counter exceptions: missing/incomplete order, wrong item, damaged-at-stage, payment/balance due, or identity/ownership dispute; route to resolution (VS-32 returns, VS-13 CX, VS-23 LP) and document

fields.Trigger: Customer books pickup; capacity planning; peak (weekend/season)
fields.Volume: ~15–30 appointments per store per day × 200 stores

workflows.name: Pickup Appointment, Time-Slot & Loading-Bay Capacity Management

Automation Opportunity: - Capacity-tied slot engine; overbooking prevention; no-show prediction; peak-surge staffing alerts
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: slots tied to capacity; bay/staff tracked; peaks planned; alternatives offered
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (ecommerce/BOPIS), VS-63 (store comms), VS-04 (staging), VS-06/VS-143 (delivery alternatives), VS-162 (self-haul), VS-64/VS-69 (seasonal/disaster peaks), W4966 (reminders), W4978 (no-show), W1193 (priority)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overbooking risk**: More appointments than bay/staff capacity → queue/waits; mitigated by capacity-tied slots
- **No-show risk**: Customer misses slot → wasted capacity + restocking (W4978); mitigated by reminders (W4966) and expiry policy
- **Peak-overload risk**: Peak crush exceeds capacity; mitigated by peak planning and alternatives
System Touchpoints: - Appointment/slot engine (VS-10/VS-63); order management (VS-10/VS-16); WMS/staging (VS-04); analytics (VS-28); store-comms (VS-63)

steps.activity: Offer & manage pickup appointments/time-slots: a time-slot booking model (online/phone/counter) tied to loading-bay capacity and staffing, smoothing arrivals across the day, and prioritizing bulky/contractor orders (links W1193 priority)

Manage loading-bay capacity: track bay/door availability, staging-space utilization, forklift/loader staffing, and the appointment queue; flag over-capacity and offer alternatives (later slot, delivery VS-06/VS-143, self-haul VS-162)
Plan for peaks: weekend/season/typhoon-recovery and promo peaks (VS-64/VS-69), surge staffing/staging, and communicate slot availability to ecommerce (VS-10) and the call center (VS-13.1)

fields.Participants: Store Ops (VS-07), HSE (VS-24), Real Estate (VS-20), Facilities (VS-138), Customer Safety (VS-147)
fields.Trigger: New store (VS-37); remodel (VS-109); safety/incident (VS-147); flow review

workflows.name: Loading-Zone Layout, Signage, Wayfinding & Pedestrian/Vehicle Flow

Automation Opportunity: - Layout/wayfinding standards library; signage-asset tracking; flow simulation; post-incident review feed
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: flow separates vehicle/pedestrian/forklift; signage complete; PWD-accessible; HSE-reviewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-20/VS-138 (facilities), VS-147 (premises safety), VS-24 (HSE), VS-37/VS-109 (open/remodel), VS-13 (PWD access), W4970 (forklift loading)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Pedestrian/forklift-conflict risk**: Poor separation → contact injury (VS-147); mitigated by flow design and demarcation
- **Wayfinding-failure risk**: Customer can't find counter/slot → friction/queue; mitigated by clear signage
- **Accessibility risk**: PWD-inaccessible pickup (RA 7277/BP 344); mitigated by accessible design
System Touchpoints: - Facilities/CMMS (VS-138); HSE (VS-24); store-comms (VS-63); asset/ signage master (VS-35/VS-29); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Design the loading-zone layout: the customer-vehicle lanes, the loading bay/doors, the staging area, pedestrian walkways, the forklift operating envelope, signage/wayfinding (entry, slot, counter, wait area), and separation of vehicle/pedestrian/forklift flows (links VS-147 premises safety, BP 344 PWD access)
steps.r: Facilities / Real Estate / HSE / Store Ops

steps.activity: Implement signage, markings & controls: lane/bay markings, directional signage, slot/QR signage, pedestrian barriers, mirrors, speed controls, forklift-zone demarcation, and PWD/accessible pickup (links VS-13/RA 7277)
Review & maintain: periodic flow/safety review, post-incident review (VS-147), maintain signage/markings/barriers, and feed the remodel program (VS-109) and customer-safety CAPA (VS-147)

fields.Participants: Store Ops (VS-07), Receiving (VS-07.3), DC (VS-04), Inventory (VS-05), CX (VS-13)
fields.Volume: ~20–40 bulky-pickup orders per store per day × 200 stores

workflows.name: Order Readiness, Pre-Stage Pick & Bulk-Goods Staging Area Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-pick task on order readiness; staging-slot allocation; completeness auto-verify; readiness auto-notify (W4966)
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: order verified before staging; completeness/condition checked; staging-slot tracked; readiness SLA
Cross-references: - links to VS-07.3 (receiving), VS-05 (inventory), VS-04 (staging), VS-10/VS-16 (order), VS-09/VS-11 (special/B2B), VS-115 (catch-weight), W4962 (counter), W4966 (notification), W4978 (hold-expiry)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Not-ready risk**: Customer arrives but order not staged → CX failure; mitigated by readiness SLA and notification (W4966)
- **Wrong/incomplete-order risk**: Wrong/short order staged → return/complaint (VS-32/VS-13); mitigated by pre-arrival verification
- **Staging-congestion risk**: Staging area overflows → lost/mixed orders; mitigated by slot mgmt and hold-expiry (W4978)
System Touchpoints: - WMS/staging (VS-04); inventory (VS-05); order management (VS-10/VS-16); special orders (VS-09/VS-11); calibration (VS-115); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Pick & pre-stage the order: on order readiness, pick the bulky items (lumber/tile/cement/appliance) from yard/sales-floor/backroom (links VS-07.3 receiving, VS-05 inventory), verify against the order, and stage in the designated staging area tagged to the customer/order/slot

Verify readiness & condition: confirm completeness (no shorts), condition (no damage W4979), special-order correctness (VS-09/VS-11), and catch-weight/cut-to-length accuracy (VS-115); flag exceptions before customer arrival
Manage the staging area: staging-slot utilization, FIFO/expiry (no stale holds — links W4978), segregation of customer orders, and feed the readiness notification (W4966) and counter (W4962)

fields.Trigger: Order ready (W4965); appointment reminder; customer arrival

workflows.name: Customer Notification, Arrival Confirmation & Queue Management

Automation Opportunity: - Readiness auto-notify (SMS/email/app); queue/check-in app; ETA auto-calc; no-show auto-flag
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: readiness notification sent on SLA; arrival verified; queue managed; privacy-compliant (VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (BOPIS SLA/W4805 journey), VS-13 (CX/comms), VS-13.1 (queue), VS-91 (privacy), W4962 (counter), W4965 (readiness), W4978 (no-show/expiry)
Pain Points / Risks: - **No-notification risk**: Customer not told order is ready → stale hold/no-show; mitigated by readiness notifications
- **Queue-friction risk**: Long unmanaged wait → CX failure; mitigated by queue mgmt and ETA
- **Privacy risk**: Customer contact data over-used (RA 10173); mitigated by consent and minimal use (VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Notification/communications (VS-10/VS-13); order management (VS-10/VS-16); queue mgmt (VS-13.1); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Notify the customer on readiness & appointment: SMS/email/app notification (order ready, slot time, counter/bay location, what to bring — ID, vehicle type) per the SLA (links VS-10 BOPIS SLA, W4805 pickup journey)
Confirm arrival & manage the queue: on arrival, check in the customer (order/ID), confirm the vehicle (for loading W4970), manage the wait/queue, and communicate ETA/position
Manage no-shows & expiries: remind approaching-slot customers, handle no-shows (W4978 — expiry/restock per policy), and re-book; feed CX analytics (W4981)

fields.Owner: Will-Call Counter Supervisor / Ecommerce Ops (VS-10) / Store Ops
fields.Participants: Ecommerce (VS-10), Store Ops (VS-07), B2B/Trade (VS-11), Special Orders (VS-09), CX (VS-13)

workflows.name: BOPIS / Ecommerce / Special-Order Pickup Integration at the Will-Call Counter

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time status sync; mixed-basket completeness check; balance-due gate; cross-channel exception routing
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: status real-time across channels; mixed-basket reconciled; balance-due gate enforced
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (BOPIS/W534/W4805), VS-08 (POS), VS-16 (order mgmt), VS-60 (omnichannel), VS-09/VS-11 (special/B2B), VS-74 (contractor), W4962 (counter), W4965 (staging), W4970 (loading)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Status-mismatch risk**: Online says ready, store says not → CX failure; mitigated by real-time status sync
- **Mixed-basket risk**: Multi-origin order partially staged → incomplete release; mitigated by pre-release reconciliation (VS-10 W534)
- **Balance-due risk**: Special order released before final payment → loss; mitigated by the balance check
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce/order mgmt (VS-10/VS-16); POS (VS-08); omnichannel routing (VS-60); special orders (VS-09/VS-11); staging (VS-04); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Integrate BOPIS/ecommerce pickup at the will-call counter: the online order (VS-10 BOPIS) → pick/stage (W4965) → readiness notify (W4966) → counter release (W4962), with mixed-basket/multi-origin orders (links VS-10 W534) reconciled before release
steps.r: Ecommerce Ops / Counter Staff / Store Ops

steps.activity: Integrate special-order & B2B/trade pickup: special orders (VS-09 W744/W545, VS-11 trade) → notify on arrival → counter release with deposit/balance check (links VS-09/VS-11) → bulky loading (W4970); handle project/contractor bulk (VS-11/VS-74)

Reconcile status across channels: ensure order status (paid, staged, released) is consistent across ecommerce (VS-10), POS (VS-08), order mgmt (VS-16), and the counter; manage cross-channel exceptions (links VS-10/VS-60)

fields.Owner: Loading-Zone Supervisor / Self-Haul Rental (VS-162) / Store Ops
fields.Participants: Self-Haul Rental (VS-162), Store Ops (VS-07), CX (VS-13), HSE (VS-24)
fields.Trigger: Customer rents self-haul vehicle (VS-162) or arrives in own/hired vehicle
fields.Volume: ~800–1,200 self-haul rentals + customer-vehicle pickups per month × 200 stores

Automation Opportunity: - Rental-order link; vehicle-suitability check from order dimensions; rental-window-aware scheduling
Controls: - CTL-743 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Pickup & Will-Call Program Design, Capacity & Scheduling (PA-171.1).)
- CTL-743: rental linked to order; vehicle suitability verified; load securement checked (W4972); rental window managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-162 (self-haul rental), VS-06/VS-143 (delivery alternatives), VS-10/VS-16 (order), VS-04 (staging), W4970 (loading), W4972 (securement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vehicle-mismatch risk**: Load too big/heavy for the vehicle → unsafe overload or failed pickup; mitigated by suitability check
- **Rental-window risk**: Loading delays exceed rental time → extension charges/customer friction; mitigated by scheduling around the window
- **Coordination-failure risk**: Rental and order not linked → customer stranded; mitigated by the rental-order link
System Touchpoints: - Self-haul rental (VS-162); order mgmt (VS-10/VS-16); staging (VS-04); delivery alternatives (VS-06/VS-143); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Coordinate the self-haul rental + pickup: when a customer rents a self-haul vehicle (VS-162) or hires transport, link the rental to the order, schedule pickup/loading around the rental window, and stage the order to match the vehicle capacity
steps.r: Self-Haul Rental / Loading Supervisor / Store Ops

steps.activity: Verify vehicle suitability: confirm the customer's vehicle (rented/owned/hired) can safely carry the load (size/weight/load rating — e.g., lumber length, appliance weight, tile pallet), and offer alternatives (delivery VS-06/VS-143, larger rental VS-162) if not

Manage rental-return & handoff: coordinate loading (W4970) within the rental window, load securement (W4972), the customer departure, and the rental return (VS-162); handle delays/extensions (links VS-162)
